page.overview:
Who is Arkin Bel?

Arkin Bel was a male Human spacer living during the Galactic War. Around 3642 BBY he was on Hoth, where Maya Drin asked him to rescue the captive Ortolans, but he refused.

Arkin Bel appears in the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic during the heroic mission "Humanitarian Aid" on Hoth.
